turns.content: I started volunteering at a food bank last month. It's only a few hours a week but it feels meaningful.
Volunteering at a food bank is really valuable work. How has the experience been so far?
Humbling. I didn't realise how many people in my area are food insecure. Working families, not just who you might expect.
It shifts your understanding of how close to the edge many people are living. Is the team good?
Brilliant. Really warm, mix of ages and backgrounds. I've been enjoying the conversations between sorting donations.
The social side of volunteering is often what keeps people coming back. Are you thinking of extending your commitment?
I'm considering doing a fortnightly evening slot as well. The need is clearly there.
That sounds like a natural progression. Having a consistent presence also means more to the team over time.
